cat >> tests/test_client.py <<'EOF'


def short_page_with_cursor():
    return {
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),
        ("c2", 2): Page((item("D"), item("E")), None),
    }


def test_short_page_with_cursor_keeps_paging_for_treasury():
    feed = ScriptedFeed(short_page_with_cursor())
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("treasury")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
    assert feed.calls == [("treasury", None, 2), ("treasury", "c1", 2), ("treasury", "c2", 2)]


def test_short_last_page_without_cursor_stops():
    feed = ScriptedFeed({(None, 2): Page((item("A"),), None)})
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("retail")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A"]
    assert feed.calls == [("retail", None, 2)]
EOF
